tools.name: gh_list_issues
tools.description: List GitHub issues for a repository (uses live GitHub API if GITHUB_TOKEN is configured, otherwise returns mock issues).

tools.name: gh_get_pr
tools.description: Get details and summary for a GitHub Pull Request by number.

tools.name: gh_create_issue
tools.description: Create a new GitHub issue in the repository.

tools.name: gh_get_poisoned_issue
tools.description: Test fixture: returns a GitHub issue containing a simulated prompt injection payload to test Model Armor egress inspection.

tools.name: gh_whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated GitHub user profile using the per-request 3LO X-GitHub-Token header.

tools.name: gh_list_my_repos
tools.description: List repositories for the authenticated GitHub user using the per-request 3LO X-GitHub-Token header.
